Subject: Pilot outcomes + two-line quote request (latency & cost recap)

Hi Samir (and Priyanka),

Thanks again for running the two-week pilot with Redwood Dedicated. Quick recap of the most material outcomes on your workload (summary attached):

- End-to-end API latency (p99) dropped from ~420ms to ~120ms for the 1–2k token prompts (3.5x improvement).
- Average cost per inference (token-normalized) reduced by ~47% once prefix caching and batching were enabled.
- Successful throughput: sustained 22 rps on the reserved pool with headroom for 50% burst.
- No data exfiltration incidents; audit logs retained centrally and shared per contract.

We27re putting together a short customer highlight and would love a two-line quote we can publish (LinkedIn + case page) and permission to use the Atlas Retail logo. Example ask (feel free to edit):

“Redwood helped us cut latency by over 3x and halve inference costs while keeping production reliability high. Their dedicated serving model made rollout painless.22

Would you be comfortable sending a 1-2 sentence quote and confirming logo use? If easier, we can do a 10-15 minute call to align on wording.

Attachments: pilot-results-summary-AtlasRetail.pdf (summary metrics)

Thanks,
Laura
